source_title: Top Team Insights: Embrace Limitless Challenges to Strengthen Advanced Packaging Tech, Motto of P&T Head Woojin Choi
claim_relevant_visible_text: After wafers undergo the semiconductor front-end process in fabs, P&T oversees the back-end process where wafers are packaged into products and tested to ensure they meet customer expectations.
researcher_paraphrase: SK hynix explicitly places Package & Test after front-end wafer fabrication and identifies advanced packaging technologies such as TSV and MR-MUF as critical to HBM product development, establishing a separate back-end production stage rather than treating HBM output as wafer output alone.
precision_guard: This source establishes stage separation and packaging importance. It does not prove that SK hynix packaging was capacity-constrained at this exact date or quantify a packaging-versus-wafer bottleneck share.
authority_boundary: SK hynix is primary for its own package-and-test process description and technology strategy, not an independent industry-wide bottleneck measurement.
